content.title: Is Michael B. Jordan Dating Again After Lori Harvey? Inside Oscar Winner's Super Secret Love Life
content.text: Michael B. Jordan is all over the headlines for his historic win of the 'Best Actor' title for his critically acclaimed dual role in Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards. While the 39-year-old was visibly stunned after this emotional victory, he quickly composed himself as he walked up the stage and thanked his family, who literally travelled across borders to be with him on this big night. "My dad came in from Ghana to be here... my family are here," Jordan said during his award acceptance speech. As the actor is enjoying one of the biggest moments of his career, his personal life remains a topic of intrigue. It didn't go unnoticed that Jordan's appearances in award shows in the past year have featured not a girlfriend, but his loving mother. And fans keep wondering how, despite being one of Hollywood's most attractive men, Jordan has managed to keep his love life so private, especially after his "heartbreaking" split from Steve Harvey's daughter, Lori Harvey. With the attention turning towards Jordan's dating scene these days, let us take a look at the Oscar winner's high-profile relationships, and whether he has given love another chance after his 2022 split from Harvey. Inside Michael B. Jordan's relationship with Lori Harvey, and how it changed his approach to dating Jordan and Harvey became one of the most talked-about celebrity couples since they hard-launched their relationship in public. The pair began dating in late 2020 and made their relationship Instagram official in early 2021. Harvey became a constant presence by the Sinners star's side and often accompanied him in major events, including the Vanity Fair Oscars after-party. Both Harvey and Jordan openly expressed their love; their social media pages were filled with cutesy couple moments. They were quite vocal about supporting each other's careers. However, after a year and a half of dating, things started to fall apart, and in 2022, they parted ways. Continue reading below While neither Jordan nor Harvey publicly commented on their split, insiders told media outlets at the time that they were simply at different places in life. While Jordan was reportedly ready for a long-term commitment, Harvey, then 25, wanted to focus on her career. The breakup was difficult for them both, because the love was still there. A source told PEOPLE in 2022: "He (Jordan) let down his guard with her, opening up emotionally in a romantic relationship for the first time. They had great times together and brought out the best in each other." While Lori Harvey has since moved on with F1 actor Damson Idris, there has been no public confirmation about Michael B. Jordan's relationship status. Insiders say the actor has faced years of "heartache" and rarely connected with anyone like he did with Harvey. Take a look at the other women who the actor had been linked with over the years before Harvey. Michael B. Jordan's rumoured romances before Lori Harvey Michael B. Jordan has always been super secretive about his love life, but that hasn't stopped fans from guessing. In the beginning of 2020, months before he started being seen with Lori Harvey, the actor was rumoured to be dating rapper Megan Thee Stallion. The pair was seen side-by-side on multiple occasions, especially at fashion events, exchanging laughs and looking comfortable in each other's company. Internet sleuths also noticed their flirty exchanges on comments. However, neither confirmed that they were ever romantically involved. Before this, in 2019, Jordan sparked dating buzz with actress Kiki Layne after their appearance at the Sundance Film Festival. The two were reportedly seen chatting and appearing flirtatious at an event, and fans soon started speculating a possible romance. Again, neither of them confirmed the buzz. Shortly before Kiki, that same year, Jordan was photographed with French supermodel Cindy Bruna as they walked out after a dinner outing in New York City. Their chemistry appeared natural and relaxed, and it was not the only time that they were seen together. However, the rumours eventually died down and nothing was confirmed. In 2015, Jordan sparked relationship rumours with supermodel Kendall Jenner, especially after the two were reported to be seen leaving a Met Gala after-party together. It didn't take long for the dating buzz to spread online, but Jordan later clarified that Jenner was simply a friend. Did Michael B. Jordan date again after his 2022 split from Lori Harvey? Well, the short answer is no. Sources close to the actor have clarified that the 39-year-old actor didn't get romantically involved with anyone after his breakup from Lori Harvey. In 2023, the actor even joked about joining Raya, a celebrity dating app, during a Saturday Night Live appearance, hinting that he wanted to enter the dating scene again, there has been no confirmation that he has ever moved forward with the plan. A source recently told the Daily Mail: "His parents would love for him to meet someone, but are happy that he is happy and respect that he isn't rushing." Multiple insiders describe the Black Panther star as “notoriously secretive" about dating. One source explained that the actor has now become more careful about relationships and wants to be sure that people are interested him not for fame, but for the right reasons. That caution may explain why the actor has spent much of this year’s awards season walking red carpets with someone else important in his life: his mother, Donna Jordan, who supported him during his early acting days. For now, the Oscar winner appears to be focused on his career and personal growth. And before he gives his heart to anyone again, he wants to be sure that he is loved for who he is on the inside.
